mapper.select: select table_name, create_time, engine, table_collation as coding, table_comment as remark from information_schema.tables where table_schema = (select database()) and table_name like concat('%', #{tableName}, '%') order by create_time desc

select column_name, if(is_nullable = 'NO', 1, 0) not_null, data_type as column_type, column_comment as remark, column_key key_type, extra, column_default from information_schema.columns where table_name = #{tableName} and table_schema = (select database()) order by ordinal_position
